newsitem.title: USA: Ohio unemployment up 0.1 pct in April to 4.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ohio unemployment up 0.1 pct in April to 4.8 pct.

text.p: Ohio's seasonally adjusted unemployment rate rose 0.1 percent in April to 4.8 percent, the same as it stood in April 1996, said Ohio Bureau of Employment Services.
"Ohio continues to have a very strong labor market," bureau adminstrator Debra Bowland said in a news release late Friday. "The April data showed good relative strength in most economic categories."
Ohio had "especially strong" demand in the service industries and strong demand in the manufacturing despite scattered losses in the auto industry and the primary metals, the bureau reported.
The U.S. unemployment rate for April was 4.9 percent, down from 5.2 percent in March, the bureau reported.
